Player moves 3 per arrow inside FLOOR; a step into a block kicks it instead (player stays) and the block slides 3 per tick as a push chain.
The chain stops when any member would leave FLOOR, overlap the player, or enter a socket interior (bbox minus 1px rim) of a different size. That size-fit guard is the only fit relation the data shows (token_1 stops at x=12).
Clicking a block gives the player that block's rect and removes the block; blocks are renamed token_i by (y,x). Stateless.
